# FDE Mastery

> FDE Mastery is a governed execution platform for teams building, integrating, and operating enterprise AI agents and workflows.

FDE Mastery is a Python-centered modular monolith with explicit control-plane, data-plane and trust-plane boundaries. The canonical production package is `packages/platform-core`. Historical Months 1–6 curriculum is isolated under `legacy/curriculum`.

## Start here

- [Project README](README.md): purpose, capabilities, quick start, installation and usage.
- [Getting started](docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): local development setup.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): documentation map and recommended reading paths.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/README.md): platform boundaries and dependency rules.
- [API reference](docs/api/README.md): versioned HTTP API and SDK contracts.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): runtime environment settings.
- [Deployment](DEPLOYMENT.md): deployment model and operational configuration.
- [Production readiness](docs/PRODUCTION-READINESS.md): domain promotion gates.
- [Build status](docs/BUILD-STATUS.md): historical build ledger and verification notes.
- [Security standards map](docs/SECURITY-STANDARDS-MAP.md): engineering control references.
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/): accepted architecture decision records.

## Repository map

- `packages/platform-core`: canonical platform runtime, gateways, policies, workflows, persistence, domains, evaluations and security controls.
- `apps`: application and worker boundaries.
- `sdks/python`: Python API client.
- `sdks/typescript`: TypeScript API client.
- `platformctl`: platform manifest and diagnostic CLI.
- `infrastructure`: infrastructure ownership surface.
- `legacy/curriculum`: historical learning curriculum, not the production dependency graph.
- `.github/workflows`: quality, SDK and evaluation workflows.

## Platform domains

Cybersecurity, Finance, HealthTech, Logistics, Legal, RevOps, Procurement and Custom.

## Important constraints

- Model output is not an authorization decision.
- Authorization and tenant boundaries must be enforced server-side.
- High-impact actions require policy enforcement and appropriate human approval.
- Example datasets are synthetic or illustrative.
- Repository CI does not prove customer-production deployment, certification or regulatory compliance.
- Do not expose secrets, customer records or sensitive prompts in logs or public issues.
